disputes.a: PowerPyx: it raises the Progress counter +1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot; whether it is required is unconfirmed. The author did it, then earned the trophy.
disputes.b: GTABase and KeenGamer: same position — unconfirmed whether required, do it anyway.
disputes.call: No source says it is safe to skip. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1; treat it as required until a source proves otherwise.
disputes.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation REQUIRED for Positive Mental Attitude?

disputes.a: 28: EGamers, Insider Gaming, GTABase, games.gg, CryptoGames, GamesFuze (27 bronze + 1 gold).
disputes.b: 27: Push Square, as reported by sixshore.
disputes.call: This guide uses 28 and names all 28 (games.gg roster). The one-trophy gap is a single outlet's count; the roster itself is consistent across five sources.
disputes.q: How many trophies are hidden on PSN — 28 or 27?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: complete the UFO easter egg — road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, at night after 2AM, solo; blinking car, follow the path, approach the UFO, help the abducted woman.
disputes.b: KeenGamer: hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method.
disputes.call: PowerPyx gives a concrete, checkable method; KeenGamer had not confirmed one at publication. Follow PowerPyx, and expect the spawn to be slightly random.
disputes.q: How do you unlock The Truth Is Out There?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds; crowded areas (Vice City, Ocean Beach).
disputes.b: KeenGamer: precise method still being confirmed.
disputes.call: Same shape as D3: one concrete method vs one outlet still confirming. Follow PowerPyx.
disputes.q: How do you unlock Ten Pin?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: hunt a unique animal for Bret; 'still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this.' Bret's line runs through 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100%.
disputes.b: No second source names the animal either.
disputes.call: Work Bret's questline and clear the Target Decks; the trophy is expected to land along the way. Do not chase one specific animal on a rumour.
disputes.q: Which animal unlocks Fair Game for Bret?

disputes.a: PowerPyx confirms 4: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie do NOT count.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: 'there are more strangers yet to be discovered' — the full qualifying set is not pinned down yet.
disputes.call: Do the 4 confirmed strands first, then keep clearing stranger questlines until the tracker hits 8. Track it in the PSN trophy list.
disputes.q: Which stranger strands count for Strangers & Freaks?

disputes.b: 250+ hours: Push Square, as reported by sixshore.
disputes.call: Plan on 200 hours for the roadmap (60–80 story, ~100 100%-sweep, ~10 cleanup); the 250+ figure is the cautious read for slower play.
disputes.q: How long does the platinum take — ~200h or 250h+?

disputes.a: TechWiser (via EGamers): the chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: all trophy-related quest givers stay available after the story; Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3.
disputes.call: No trophy is reported lost by waiting. Start each chain when it appears (cheap insurance), but PowerPyx's after-story availability is the position this guide follows.
disputes.q: Do the five stranger quest-giver chains have missable windows?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: You Gotta Know When to Get Off unlocks after the final mission 'Starting From Zero'; Snow Storm is the Chapter 5 mission trophy (Operation Savage Glory).
disputes.b: Beebom and CULTR (via EGamers) word the final mission as Chapter 5.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's mission-by-mission mapping. Chapter labels differ by outlet; the mission names do not.
disputes.q: Is the final-mission trophy a Chapter 5 trophy?
